name: Tolliver Corner
description: A collapsed brick corner on the tide line with vines through the roof and a scorch line under them. Somebody baked here once, six days a week, at four in the morning. Nobody has since.

variants.description: The Tolliver Safehouse: lamps in the cellar, a barricade across the alley, and four generations of one family who never had to sell the freehold. Everyone on this coast knows that a green pennant means a door that opens at night and nobody asking whose side you are on.
A collapsed brick corner and a scorch line under the vines, a hundred and seventeen years old. You were standing in this doorway when the brick was still warm.
